description: Venus yield ranking, and whether moving pays for itself, the paid half (0.10 USD1, or half that in $BOBAI, or nothing for a wallet holding 1,000,000 $BOBAI (holder pass over x402: a signature, no transaction — terms in the reply)): Every Venus core-pool market ranked by supply APY, computed from the rate per block and a block time measured against the chain rather than the 10,512,000-blocks-a-year constant most published BSC yield figures still use — which understates these rates by about 6.7x. Cross-checked on the chain: each market's supply rate is re-derived from its borrow rate, utilisation and reserve factor (the rule Venus's rate model pays by), and Venus's published APY is compared on top when their API answers — every row and the summary say what agreed, and a divergence is named. Given an amount and what you earn today it returns the days until a move pays for its own gas, which below a certain position size is never. Calling this tool returns the terms; the answer is sold over x402 at https://agent.brainonbnb.com/answer?service=yield_plan (or hired through the ERC-8183 escrow for 0.10 $U).
